text:
Priya: quick heads-up — candidate for SRE onsite requested an ASL interpreter and is in CET. Current panel is Fri 3pm PT which is ~11pm CET. They asked if we can move earlier so it's before 9pm CET. Anyone able to swap slots?

Sam: I can move if Ajay can cover my 4pm slot. Ajay? :wave:

Ajay: I can take Sam's 4pm. Which order do we need reviewers in? and is the take-home still weighted heavier for this role?

Priya: thanks! preferred order is infra -> systems design -> culture. For weighting, hiring mgr asked to keep take-home at 50% and onsite at 50% for this loop (changed from previous 60/40). I'll update the rubric doc.

Elena: quick rubric clarification — for infra questions let's mark "operational troubleshooting" separately (score 1-4) so we can track regressions. Also, please record consent line in the invite for the interpreter.

Priya: adding consent and interpreter note to calendar. devex-bot, can you emit the calendar template we use for accommodations?

devex-bot: sure — suggested invite body:```
Event: SRE onsite (panel)
When: Fri 2024-06-14 2:00pm PT (moved earlier)
Panel: Priya, Ajay, Elena, Sam (backup)
Notes: ASL interpreter requested — candidate confirmed. Please include recording consent and interpreter presence in the start script.
Rubric: take-home 50%, onsite 50% — infra has a separate "operational troubleshooting" 1-4 field.
```

Sam: perfect. I'll swap now and update my calendar. Priya — can you ping hiring manager to confirm the new time?

Priya: on it, and I'll drop a short debrief reminder: 24h debrief window, use the rubric link. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ajay: ack — I'll prep 2-3 targeted infra prompts (short troubleshooting scenarios) and post them here before the interview.

Sam: thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround.

Priya: closing the loop: hiring mgr confirmed, interpreter booked. moving event to 2pm PT. If any conflicts, flag here ASAP.
